profile.name: Charge Robotics
profile.summary: Builds portable factories that ship to utility-scale solar sites, robotically assemble tracker, bracket, fastener and panel parts into completed solar bays, and place them in the field with a robotic vehicle.
profile.buyerPersona: Construction or operations leader at a utility-scale solar EPC contractor

icp.label: Project size
icp.value: Roughly 150 MW and up, where repetitive mechanical install justifies mobilizing a factory

icp.label: Project stage
icp.value: Construction started or imminent, with mechanical installation still ahead

icp.label: Pain
icp.value: Labor shortages limiting how much solar a contractor can build

competitors: AES Maximo solar installation robot (developed in-house by AES)
expansion: More factories per site for 24/7 operation
Repeat deployment across an EPC contractor's project backlog

pack.title: Tormes Solar Pilot Pack: one factory on one block with SOLV Energy
pack.baselineLabel: Estimated manual mechanical install effort for the full site (estimate, not measured)
assumptions: All figures are planning estimates and must be replaced with SOLV Energy's actual site data.
Project size is 457 MWdc, from public reporting.
Module size is taken as 650 W, a rule of thumb in line with Black Hollow Sun's public figures (324 MWp, more than 500,000 panels). That gives about 703,000 modules.
Rule of thumb, not sourced: 0.5 manual labor-hours per module for mechanical installation. 703,000 modules x 0.5 = 351,500 labor-hours.
Assumed deal value and win rate are placeholders, not quotes or forecasts.
No Charge Robotics performance figure is assumed. The pilot exists to measure one.
pack.successTest: On the pilot block, the factory reduces mechanical install labor-hours per module by {pct}% against a matched manual block, with no increase in quality rework or safety incidents.
approvers: Project owner's representative for Matrix Renewables
risks: Install may have moved too far since the June 2026 groundbreaking for a pilot block to remain.
Tracker and module compatibility with this site has not been confirmed.
The matched manual block may differ in terrain, which would skew the comparison.
The owner may need to approve a change in install method.
pack.pathToOrder: Confirm remaining scope, agree the matched blocks and the {pct} target, run the pilot, review measured results with the approvers, then scope factories for SOLV Energy's next project.
